run_usps_handler: run the usps_handler function to load USPS dataset from a given dataset path and return metadata with split generators
parse_label_and_image_from_line: parse a LIBSVM format line string into a numpy image array and integer label using _parse_label_and_image_from_line
rescale_image_pixel_range: rescale a numpy image array from one pixel value range to another using _rescale_image_back_to_pixel_range
review_usps_dataset: review the usps_dataset DownloadableDataset object to inspect download URLs, checksums, and the handler function
summarize_usps_handler: summarize the usps_handler function which generates 16x16 grayscale images and labels from bz2 compressed USPS data files
